description: Canonical v1.0.0 public library ingestion and Encyclopedia Galactica clearinghouse for leadpiperl1/wookiw-ewok, organized across five wings: (1) docs/ (The Happy Hobo's Guide, Walking Naked Among Strangers, The Resonance of Stone Acts I-V, The Silmarillion of the Imperfect Void v5.0.0, PIN IN THE MAP v1.3.0, The Ursine & Urshwera Manifest v4.0.0, 50 Gemini Notebooks, and 18 Keep Axiom Notes); (2) papers/ (Master Omnibus Compendium v4.1.0/v4.1.1, Four-Paper Dispersive-Ternary Series, Unified Ramanujan Compendium v1.4.1, Voynich Codex Decoded v1.0.0, and 38-Document Positronium Archive); (3) audio/ (18 multiscale 7-string fan-fret and acoustic field recordings + Die LebeSongen master archive); (4) assets/ (50+ 300-DPI state maps, Sonic Cartography plates, and Positronium visual anchors); and (5) workspace_pearls/ (70+ versioned Soliton Retrieval Waveguides and Dandelion OS v3.0-v4.1.1 specifications).
